messages:
lucy: Heads up: billing flagged by QA after a simulated router flit. We saw provisional rows accumulate when a streaming toolcall retried and then truncated. Example log below.

omar: paste snippet + model/route?

lucy: model=rwd-7b, route=eu-west-1-prod (shard-A -> shard-B failover). Logs: `2026-05-08T21:02:10Z stream.start sid=s-77 seq=0`, `2026-05-08T21:02:11Z router.handoff sid=s-77 from=shard-A to=shard-B handoff_tmp=tmp-9`, `2026-05-08T21:02:11Z toolcall.ack seq=30 client_eof=true truncated=true`, `2026-05-08T21:02:12Z ledger.provisional id=pv-77 tokens=260`, `2026-05-08T21:02:12Z ledger.final id=fn-78 tokens=96 confirmed=true`

pdevbot: Automated check: invoice shows only provisional rows retained for sess s-77; final did not replace provisional. Possible tombstone loss.

peyton: Do we have a durable handoff identifier today? I think router hands off using ephemeral claim ids that do not survive reconnects.

alex: correct. Current flow: ephemeral claim on each hop, ledger rows only reference session_id + replica_tag. If the seq space resets on the new shard we can't match.

nina: UX ask: customers see two ledger lines and assume double-billed. We need both a backend invariant (final wins) and better console messaging explaining provisional semantics.

lucy: engineering proposal: 1) add a stable `x-handoff-id` header generated on the first route claim and persisted client-side for the lifetime of the logical request. 2) runtime must write tombstone rows when an incoming handoff indicates prior in-flight state should be invalidated. 3) ledger stores handoff_id on all provisional/final/tombstone rows.

omar: tombstone semantics: tombstone row should reference `prev_row_id` and include `prev_token_count` and `last_ack_seq`. Helps audits. Also tombstones must be emitted before confirm to avoid race where confirm arrives and tombstone later tries to cancel it.

alex: for correctness we can perform a CAS on ledger writes keyed by handoff_id. Only the winning shard's confirm will set `confirmed=true`; tombstone is simply a write that marks prior provisional as stale atomically. CAS required to avoid both provisional+confirm being considered active.

peyton: metrics: add `ledger.tombstone.count`, `ledger.tombstone.latency_ms`, and `billing.duplicate_alerts` (sessions with provisional AND confirmed treated as both). Dashboards: top offending routes and percent of sessions resolved by tombstone. Alert: if duplicate_alerts > 5/min across cluster.

nina: console: render grouped rows by handoff_id; collapsed view shows single authoritative row (prefer final if present), with an expand chevron to inspect provisional+tombstone history. Show a contextual help tooltip about "optimistic provisional charges".

omar: rollout plan: Phase 1: runtime header + tombstone emission in canary; ledger accepts tombstone rows and exposes query by handoff_id. Phase 2: console folding logic + instrumentation and one-week observation window. Phase 3: automated small refunds for clear tombstone-final mismatches after manual QA sign-off.

lucy: tests: unit tests for ledger CAS, integration harness that replays handoff + truncated toolcall + confirm interleavings, and UI e2e to assert collapse behavior. Also run load tests to ensure tombstone write rate doesn't spike DB contention.

alex: edgecases: background embed jobs and prefetch create separate sessions. We need to propagate a parent_handoff_id to child requests or attach an invoice_group_id to dedupe at billing stage.

peyton: data retention: tombstones should be queryable for at least 90 days for audit; create `ledger.tombstone.retention_days` config.

nina: customer messaging: add a billing FAQ entry explaining provisional lines and our dedupe approach. Include sample timeline images.

omar: created issue rwd/infra#4728 with acceptance criteria and test matrix. Linking here.

lucy: owners: runtime=alex, ledger=omar, console=nina, product=lucy. Sync scheduled Thu 9am to review canary telemetry.

alex: ack runtime owner. Will add header API and CAS logic.

omar: ack ledger. I'll add tombstone schema and metrics.

pdevbot: Incident INC-2026-1622 created and linked to rwd/infra#4728.

nina: ack console. I'll draft UI copy.
